governingIdea: The collection is a plate book. Each Atelier composition is a catalogue plate — the supplied studio render with its rectangle dissolved so the car stands in a pool of light on the page's own ground — and the colour facts are its record, set as a hairline plate rather than as marketing copy. The page is read as a set of two entries, not as two campaign frames.

operations.governs: the presentation of every exterior: an elliptical mask derived from the car's measured bounding box (x 0.162-0.761, y 0.228-0.835 of the 16:9 frame) reaches zero at the frame's four edges and stays opaque past every extreme point of the silhouette, so the studio rectangle dissolves and the car stands on the page uncropped
operations.workItDoes: the studio rectangle disappears; the car stands in a pool of light on the page's own ground instead of inside a box. Verified on the render: hero.json reports the declared subject box clipped on no side at 1440 or 390, and the annotated frame shows the box containing the vehicle.

operations.governs: the plate carries its own field, so no layer edge is ever hidden only by the ground beneath it
operations.workItDoes: the light travels with the plate, so nothing painted over the image can leave an edge on the section's ground. Measured: the cover's bottom edge samples exactly #0d0e11 across the section boundary — no seam.

operations.governs: interiors keep a rectangular frame while exteriors dissolve — two image treatments, one stated rule: an exterior is an object on a floor, an interior is a view
operations.workItDoes: the two interiors keep a committed rectangular frame while the three exteriors dissolve — the page reads an exterior as an object on a floor and an interior as a view.

operations.governs: the page alternates axis rather than centring — manifesto right, heritage headline left, entry 01 image-left, entry 02 record-left
operations.workItDoes: the reading axis moves right, left, left, right down the page, so the chapters are told apart before they are read.

operations.governs: entry 01 is read image-first with its record hung off the car's shoulder; entry 02 is read record-first on the mirrored axis with a smaller exterior held high and the interior descending from the left bleed
operations.workItDoes: entry 01 is read image-first with the record at the car's shoulder and the release in the lower LEFT; entry 02 is read record-first with a smaller exterior held high and the release in the lower RIGHT. Reconciled with the detector in gate2.humanInventory.

operations.governs: every colour fact is a hairline spec plate with a subordinate key column, never a box, a card or a caption
operations.implementedBy: css/page.css .spec (grid, hairline border-block-start, subordinate key column)
operations.workItDoes: the colour facts scan as a record rather than as marketing prose, and the value column forms the reading line.

operations.governs: Rosso appears in exactly one interface role, the primary control fill; the red of the marque reaches the page through the car itself
operations.workItDoes: Rosso marks where the action is and nowhere else; the marque's red reaches the page through the car itself. Measured: the accent occupies well under 1% of the first screen (cta share 0.5%).

operations.governs: the masthead keeps a scrim while it is still travelling over the cover and takes an opaque ground only once its bottom edge has cleared the cover's
operations.implementedBy: js/page.js masthead--solid toggled at cover.offsetHeight - head.offsetHeight; css .masthead::before scrim
operations.visibleAt: on scroll, at the cover's lower edge
operations.workItDoes: no hard horizontal line is ever drawn through the headline: the bar keeps a scrim for the whole length of the cover and takes its opaque ground only after it has left it.

operations.governs: the mobile plate's width and offset are computed from the car's own centre so the subject is centred and whole at 390 and at 320 — not inherited from the desktop crop
operations.workItDoes: the car's own centre (0.4615 of the frame) lands on the viewport centre, so the subject is whole and symmetrically placed. Measured on the render: clearance 40.8px left and 40.8px right at 390, nothing clipped.
